bulk_copy.bridge: MISSING stripe/gather4sector line assembly + persistent tags across4controllers

HCP.policy: full coefficients locally resident; prefetch one operator before cmd_valid
HCP.read: 8 banks x W F32 coefficients/cycle; W model-selected, not default-assumed
HCP.missing: fullshape bank layout bridge, staging macro ports/area and qualified clock/cycles

SU.read: 64 F32 reads/cycle without ready; requires staged operands before go
SU.write: 16x32b vm +16x32b kv +2x32b reduction ports; arbitration required
SU.missing: packed decode/encode, staging banks, F64/I64 selection bridge, append acknowledgment

SM.missing: accepted256 assembly + activation/result routing; router-produced IDs; qualified32SM composition

hc_compute.policy: existing FP32 vector lanes/tree organization, W32 candidate
hc_compute.reason: norm rsqrt/scaling/output drain and subsequent sigmoid/Sinkhorn are not included in issue cycles
hc_compute.bank_layout: bank k, word o*80+r, lane l: fn[o][8*(r*32+l)+k]
hc_compute.activation_bank_layout: bank k, word r, lane l: flat[8*(r*32+l)+k]
hc_compute.rounding: FP32 multiply; eight contiguous products summed sequentially from+0; padded pairwise chunk tree; golden norm and mix rounding
hc_compute.qualification: source defines chunk8 order; no fullshape RTL, SS/FF or composition claim

service_schedule.controller_ingress: one request/controller/cycle; up to16x32B read sectors or one32B write
service_schedule.policy: serialize nonSM prefetch, compute and dependent matrix-weight phases; no overlap credit
service_schedule.arbitration: proposed four finite class queues per controller: weight, coefficient/table, state read, state write; oldest eligible round-robin at phase owner; do not bypass same-sector pending write
barriers: drain prior weight/collective consumers before workspace reuse
issue HCP only when all coefficient and activation staging writes complete
issue SU go only after all fixed-latency read operands staged
publish KV/index/window valid count only after paired data+scale writes commit
do not issue read after write until controller fence acknowledgment
service_schedule.state_update_protocol: single owner; read-modify-write partial32B sectors because controller has no write mask; preserve neighboring rows; fence before paired code/scale count publication
missing: finite class arbiter and credit routing not instantiated
